recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中三顆中型淋巴樣細胞核圓、染色質均勻，淡藍灰色細胞質四周伸出細毛狀突起，是毛細胞（hairy cell）的樣子。
features: Three medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei
Homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Fine, irregular hair-like cytoplasmic projections around the cell border
Thick smear area with closely packed red cells; magnification limits fine detail
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at moderate magnification shows three medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, homogeneous chromatin and moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections. Nucleoli are not conspicuous, and no other leukocytes are present in this field. Evaluation is limited by magnification and smear thickness. Findings are suggestive of hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Cells have a prominent nucleolus and lack CD25, ANXA1 and BRAF V600E.
Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi and lack the CD103/CD25/CD123 co-expression of hairy cells.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and vacuolated gray cytoplasm rather than round nuclei with hairy borders.
